verdict.rationale: jo documents a fixed set of wired-up integrations that users connect: GitHub activity in briefings, Linear issues, channel catch-up summaries and decks. The FAQ also implies a connect flow ("explore jo before you connect anything"). There is no evidence of a browsable directory or marketplace where users discover and add third-party apps. Missing for 10: a browsable third-party app/connector directory, a self-serve add/install flow, any third-party or developer-built connector ecosystem, and hands-on corroboration of how connecting works.
